scenes.narration: What if the best place to sell Nike shoes isn't a Nike store?
In fiscal 2026, Nike made 46.4 billion dollars.
About 59 percent came from selling to other stores. That's called wholesale.

visual.label: Share of Nike revenue from wholesale

scenes.narration: Wholesale brought in 27.5 billion. Nike's own stores and app brought in 17.7 billion.
And the gap grew. Wholesale rose 6 percent, while Nike Direct fell 6.
